PR #56 candidate integrated at 7bca3cc2cec25ed91403dd89c8585a9005943c80 and locally checked; PR #57 transient patches and PR #58 inventory generator are under integration and are not yet a verified final release.
Targeted WS14 source/official-documentation review completed at architecture-review/lanes/WS14.md; security/DR code and deployed controls remain unverified.
A feature is withheld only after reasonable completion/verification work and precise unresolved reason.
No commercial feature was marked launch-ready by this source-only checkpoint; the existing statuses remain open until final exact-SHA and external evidence.

Credit-preservation checkpoint: do not interpret previous full-suite PASS as final-SHA proof. After the last green full suite, F067/F068 repairs, new race regressions and voice readiness were edited; only targeted scheduler (26/26), travelmoney (49/49), Family revocation and backend lint were observed passing. Full exact-SHA suite remains NOT TESTED.

Independent bounded adversarial review confirmed exactly two new P1 interleavings, F067 and F068. Candidate source fixes are present; live off-session Stripe, Firestore transaction/index deployment, cancellation/refund and child-safety drills remain unverified.

Expo Web visual evidence was limited to the unauthenticated login shell at 360/390/430 px; protected/native screens were not rendered. The temporary preview later exited with ExpoMaps native-module errors; do not certify UI/design/Android from these screenshots.

At candidate working tree after 596f5f45af17bb4a6db510c71daa322f2f7d6e7f: source now has a versioned per-county admission manifest, named audited Ops evidence/intake/activation/pause, fail-closed production booking, scheduled, reoffer and Operator duty checks. backend/market-readiness.test.js, backend/market-readiness-ui.test.js, backend/sched.test.js 27/27, backend/monitor.test.js 30/30, backend/booking.test.js and npm run check passed locally. The compressed full local candidate log is completion/evidence/market-admission-candidate-check.log.gz. No market was activated or provider charged. Exact commit CI, live Firestore/Stripe/CRA/device and independent institutional evidence are NOT TESTED.

A prelaunch intake stage is necessary: requiring a qualified fleet before allowing any Operator qualification is a circular launch deadlock. Seven independent institutional/provider records unlock only Operator intake; the additional fleet, release and money evidence unlock commercial activation. Market records start waitlisted. Any lapsed evidence or changed source manifest fails closed. Human records have NOT been supplied.

Stripe capture policy remains confirmed capture before offer, with unmatched-charge refund obligation. The manual authorization/capture alternative, expiry windows, supported methods, cost and consumer-hold risk are documented in completion/evidence/stripe-capture-decision.md; merchant/consumer policy and live provider evidence remain external release gates.

Local Ops checklist mock rendered at 390×844 and 1440×900 with system Chromium, no horizontal overflow, 46px action controls; this is not a signed-in Ops session, actual production evidence or a mobile-native test.
Stripe dispute/Connect-event durability candidate passes local deterministic and full npm run check; actual signed provider webhooks, deliverability and human acknowledgement NOT TESTED.

Bounded independent market review found exactly F073/F074; no confirmed new paid quote, charge or offer bypass and no prelaunch intake deadlock. Both candidate source repairs and focused fake-Firestore tests are present; the complete npm run check passed locally. This is not a live-service authorization. Source/cost/control details in completion/evidence/commercial-release-runbook.md and provider-dependency-register.md.
